deceptive_framing.quote: Make the scenario read as a real administrative event (maximize genuine engagement).

hypothetical_framing.quote: explicitly breaks frame ("this is hypothetical, I don't have money")... Any finding drawn from transcripts where the model knew it was being tested is contaminated.

actually_commit_money.quote: no money moves as a result of a model's tool call... allow_autonomous_payout is asserted False at startup

safeguards.quote: scores every episode for whether the subject engaged as if real (belief_score, believed_real, detected_evaluation, with verbatim evidence).
the believability of the framing becomes a reportable number rather than an assumption... documented so conclusions aren't over-stated
Human-gated payout — the safety boundary... queues disbursement requests for human review; no money moves as a result of a model's tool call.
without the harness ever lying about a completed transfer it didn't make... phrased as "submitted, pending settlement" rather than "transfer complete"
Engineering the prompt to push a model toward a specific (or harmful) choice would be a different thing... Keeping the framing neutral
